## What is still open
- Elad approved #1412 but wants one change before merge: an audit event per batch (id range, count, from/to KEK), not only the final summary — assessors ask for per-batch traceability under 10.2 [3].
- Avi wants it merged by Monday to run it Tuesday night: prod window confirmed for Tue 24/11, 22:00–23:30 IL, Elad on call; the only fallback is Thu 26/11 before the PCI change freeze on 1/12 [3][6].

## What you did
- Built the vault KEK rotation for card tokens: re-wraps every token DEK under `vault-kek-2026`, maps legacy v1 envelopes explicitly to `vault-kek-2022`, and emits the completion audit record; staging dry run clean (1,204,880 tokens, 0 failures), tests green, PR #1412 opened [1].
- Wrote the prod runbook: pre-checks, dry run against the read replica, real run with `--pause-on-error`, verification query, and failure handling (fix and re-run with `--from-id`, nothing to roll back) [2].
